title: Figure 5. Quantum dot in bilayer graphene (device cross-section)
description: Cross-section schematic of a layered device showing "bilayer graphene" with "dopant atoms" on an SiO2 layer above a "back gate," with a "top gate" over a dielectric (ε) defining the quantum dot region labeled "QD." Captioned "Figure 5. Quantum dot in bilayer graphene." Appears in the section "Graphene Disc in Bilayer Graphene."
